note: Images from the NASA Image and Video Library (images.nasa.gov), downloaded 2026-11-14 and embedded (the image host does not allow loading from other websites).

images.title: Rover Landing Hardware at Eagle Crater, Mars
images.caption: Seen from orbit: the parachute and heat shield that landed the rover Opportunity near Eagle crater in 2004. Your base is right next door.

images.title: Dust Storm Covers Opportunity
images.caption: A real weather map made by a spacecraft orbiting Mars: the giant dust storm covering Opportunity in June 2018.

images.title: Calypso Panorama of Spirit View from Troy
images.caption: What Spirit saw from Troy, the place where it spent its last Mars winter.

images.title: Computer Reconstruction of Spirit Predicament
images.caption: A computer model of how Spirit sat stuck in soft soil at Troy in 2009, built so the team could plan how to get it out.

images.title: Geometry of Mars Solar Conjunction
images.caption: Solar conjunction: the Sun sits between Earth and Mars, and its hot gas scrambles radio signals.

images.title: Solar Storm's Radiation at Martian Orbit and Surface
images.caption: Real measurements from the September 2017 solar storm: MAVEN in orbit and Curiosity's RAD on the surface, where radiation more than doubled.

images.title: Solar Storm Triggers Whole-Planet Aurora at Mars
images.caption: During the same storm, the MAVEN orbiter saw the whole planet glow with aurora.
